entries.note: A unit's loaded heat rate is a physical characteristic of the machine — rule 13 [R-MEASURED] admissible as an INPUT (it regenerates for a forward year from the same pipeline and responds to changed conditions: a retrofit moves it, a new unit carries its design rate). It is NOT a measured outcome fed back to close a residual. Per rule 23 [R-FROZEN-DERIVE] it re-derives ONLY when CAMPD publishes new or revised vintages, and that commit must cite the data change.
